## Subagents tell the truth

- **Finished means finished.** A completed or failed child keeps its real state. Only a run whose heartbeat stopped while it was still working is labelled `unresponsive` — this replaces the older `stale` wording, which read as jargon and was applied too broadly. A successful child is never relabelled as if it had died.
- **No more phantom children.** A frozen spawn-time state can no longer outlive its run, so restarting no longer resurrects earlier children as live, and a child that has finished but stays resident for follow-ups reads `resident` instead of `working`.
- **The detail page describes the child, not the parent.** It shows the subagent's own model and its `used / limit`, uses one friendly state vocabulary with the same animated working indicator as the main conversation, and ticks a child's elapsed timers while it is actually working.

## Live child streaming

- **Thinking and text arrive while the child works**, instead of only appearing after it finishes. The reasoning text, the assistant's answer and tool calls stream into the detail page, fed by the event stream the extension publishes. Requires `@mistrjirka/pi-subagent` 0.4.4 or newer.
- Completed content is never shown twice: once a child settles, its own session file becomes the single source of truth.

## Much less transcript to scroll

- **Parallel spawns are one card.** Four spawns used to occupy around 36 rows of transcript; they now take five, with one row per child showing its identity, state, freshness and context usage. A `▸ spawn cards` toggle expands any batch back to the individual spawn cards, so the task prompts and raw tool output stay reachable.
- A single spawn, a spawn that owns no children, and any unrelated tool call between spawns keep the existing rendering — failed spawns are never hidden inside a group.

## Skills at a keystroke

- **`/skills`** opens a searchable list of every skill Pi reports, showing its description and whether it comes from your user or project configuration. Enter sends the highlighted skill; Esc closes without sending. `/commands` is unchanged.

## Compatibility

- Live child streaming needs `@mistrjirka/pi-subagent` 0.4.4 or newer. Everything else works with any subagent runtime, and legacy `pi-subagents` handling — workflow, mission, transcripts, and pause/resume/steer/stop — is unchanged.

## Validation

- PiTTy typecheck passed; focused subagent/UI suite: **256 passed, 0 failed**; complete local suite: **433 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed**.
